issue.title: package.metadata.bundle icon in Cargo.toml not generated/documented, clicking app.app doesn't start app.

repository.name: tauri
repository.description: Build smaller, faster, and more secure desktop and mobile applications with a web frontend.

issue.body:
**Describe the bug** 
Just following the wiki (using NPM over yarn), but the need for having a `package.metadata.bundle` in `Cargo.toml` is never generated, or documented. I just added it thanks to prompts in error messages. Also, after building, (`tauri build`), opening the generated `app.app` does nothing, I have to use the terminal and run the executable (`$ PATH_TO_THE APP/app.app/Contents/MacOS/app`) to start up the app.

**Expected behavior**
I expected the generated `tauri init` script to include the following in the generated `Cargo.toml`:

```
[package.metadata.bundle]
icon = [ "icons/icon.png" ]
```

Also, I expect the app to start when I click on the built `app.app`.
